title: Reorganize String Deterministically
description: Rearrange the lowercase letters of `s` so no equal characters are adjacent. Repeatedly choose, among characters different from the previous output character, the one with the greatest remaining count; break ties by choosing the alphabetically smallest character. Return the resulting string, or an empty string if no valid arrangement exists. Input: `s`. Output: the deterministic arrangement or empty string.
hints: Track only the character counts or prefixes needed to decide the next step.
Check repeated symbols, empty or minimal cases, and impossible arrangements.
